text:
Ava R: quick note — fp8 canary showed intermittent head-scale spikes in long-dialogs, causing tonal collapse around 2k+ tokens. dropping minimal logs here.
Ben C: repro steps?
Ava R: ran: 
```
rdw canary-run --model redwood-medium-fp8 --prompts tests/long_dialogs.json --seq-len 4096 --seed 11
```
Ava R: trimmed log: 
```
2026-04-03T15:22:10Z token=2064 rolling_entropy=0.33 head14_scale=11.4 head2_scale=0.95 kv_overlap=0.71
2026-04-03T15:22:10Z token=2065 topk_entropy=0.19 deg_score=0.81 repeated_fragment="..."
```
Diego M: sounds like per-head outliers that global quant_scale misses. different heads each request.
Priya S: can runtime detect & mitigate without full precision fallback? fallback costs ~2x tokens.
Ben C: three options: 
- cheap detector + full fallback: rolling_entropy < 0.45 for 4 tokens -> switch to INT8/FP16 for remainder
- soft-clamp: sigmoid clip on per-head scales when scale > knee, disable KV reuse for K tokens
- hybrid: soft-clamp first, if deg_score stays >0.75 after 8 tokens escalate to full fallback
Ava R: soft-clamp preserves perf but may subtly shift distributions. need offline eval to check hallucination risk.
Diego M: runtime sampling we need: head_scale_hist, kv_overlap_window, per-token topk_entropy, small trace of tokens + logits for incidents. metric: fp8_headspike_incident.
Priya S: product ask: add per-tenant "precision budget" so customers can opt into safe path for long-form workloads. also a precision-hint header clients can set.
Ben C: detection thresholds are tunable. tradeoffs: latency (soft-clamp negligible), cost (fallback ~1.8-2.3x), SLO impact.
OpsBot: deploy: fp8-canary-headclamp -> 10 hosts, sampling enabled, alerts muted for canary window.
BillingBot: FYI if conservative fallback used >1% of prod requests, estimated monthly infra cost +21%.
Ava R: action items:
- Diego -> implement soft-clamp prototype + feature flag (include knee param)
- Ben -> add detector + fallback hook + tests
- Priya -> precision budget + header spec for product + per-tenant config
- Ops -> run extended 72h canary, collect sampled traces, mute noisy alerts
Diego M: will include offline eval checklist: coherence, factuality, and held-out long-dialog set A/B vs FP16 path.
Ben C: also add a short-circuit: if soft-clamp doesn't improve deg_score by 20% within 10 tokens escalate to full fallback.
Priya S: opening RDW-6120 to track. tagging @SRE and @billing to monitor during canary.
Ava R: thanks all — will post canary link and sampled traces in RDW-6120. :eyes:
